correctness.rationale: Exhaustive agreement of two membership predicates over all 2^16 vertex subsets, complete ascending/descending Morse acyclicity checks over all 35,120 incidences, exact integral Morse boundary matrices with unit 5->4 pivot and remaining unit 3x3 6->5 minor; cellular cancellation proves wedge of three 6-spheres. Stage-zero integral cell cancellation gives its known wedge and connectivity implies null inclusion and the cofiber splitting. Original mod-two simplicial boundary ranks independently corroborate Betti groups. Standalone verifier plus execution record are included.
